svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in black TPU 95A, flange on the bed, slow (about 20 mm/s).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange 47 mm across and 2.5 mm thick, with a 22 mm hole; the lip of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange holds the window up into the body.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cone 18 mm deep from the body: 30 mm across at the flange, 42 mm at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rim, 3 mm wall; 36 mm inside at the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 3.4 mm holes on a 40 mm circle, at 90, 210 and 330 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (the first one toward the left side of the body).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: three M3 x 10 screws with washers through the flange and the floor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the head block inserts. Snug only: TPU creeps if overtightened.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The shroud wears; it is replaced with the same three screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rim sits flat on a sheet of glass with no light under it.
